papers.title: Ink3D: Sculpting 3D Assets with Extremely Complex Textures via Video Generative Models
papers.authors: Yue Han, Chong Li, Zhening Liu, Cong Huang, Fang Deng, Yong Liu, Fangyun Wei, Yan Lu
papers.affiliations: ZGCA & ZGCI, Microsoft Research, Zhejiang University, HKUST
papers.intro: Ink3D通过将3D几何生成与大规模视频生成模型相结合，利用轨道扫描视频生成密集多视角观测，再经神经烘焙模块实现高保真复杂纹理的合成。

papers.title: MoHallBench: A Benchmark for Motion Hallucination in Video Large Language Models
papers.authors: Jiale Li, Sihan Chen, Mengyuan Liu
papers.affiliations: Xiamen University, South China University of Technology, Peking University
papers.intro: MoHallBench是一个专门用于诊断视频大语言模型中运动幻觉的基准，系统评估了共现先验、序列推理和相似性混淆三种主要幻觉来源，并引入双向提问协议与偏差感知指标以缓解确认偏差。

papers.title: LongVQUBench: Benchmarking Long-Term Video Quality Understanding of Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Arpita Nema, Hanwei Zhu, Xi Zhang, Weisi Lin
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出LongVQUBench，一个专门用于评估大视觉语言模型长期视频质量理解能力的综合基准，通过层次化评估框架和Needle Distortion问答范式系统性地测试模型在局部、跨事件和全局尺度上的感知推理能力。

papers.title: GeoSearcher: Anchor-Guided Progressive Reasoning for Remote Sensing Visual Grounding with Process Supervision
papers.authors: Dianyu Wang, Yidan Zhang, Peirong Zhang, Xuyang Li, Xiaoxuan Liu, Lei Wang
papers.affiliations: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院（Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences）、网络信息系统技术重点实验室（Key Laboratory of Network Information System Technology）、目标认知与应用技术重点实验室（Key Laboratory of Target Cognition and Application Technology）、中国科学院大学（University of Chinese Academy of Sciences）
papers.intro: GeoSearcher 将 RSVG 重新定义为锚点引导的渐进推理过程，通过 ACR-SFT 和 PF-GRPO 两阶段后训练，使模型能够自适应地利用参考物作为锚点逐步缩小搜索区域，从而在小目标定位和复杂查询中显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: GenAU: Language-Grounded Industrial Anomaly Understanding with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Hongkuan Zhou, Tristan Rehm, Nadeem Nazer, Lavdim Halilaj, Jingcheng Wu, Steffen Staab
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多个机构，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: GenAU是一个通用视觉-语言框架，通过在指令跟随VLM中引入两个专用分割令牌（SEGdefect和SEGnormal），将隐藏状态作为语言锚点与多尺度视觉特征对齐，统一实现图像级异常检测、像素级分割、多类型识别和缺陷文本分析。

papers.title: DART: Difficulty-Adaptive Routing for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Zhengbo Zhang, Mark He Huang, Zhigang Tu, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.affiliations: Singapore University of Technology and Design; Wuhan University; University of California, Merced
papers.intro: DART通过查询条件的行列式点过程（DPP）同时完成关键帧选择和查询难度评估，并据此将简单查询路由到快速直接预测路径、复杂查询路由到带结构化时间标记提示的慢速推理路径，从而在零样本视频时间定位中显著提升复杂查询的定位精度。

papers.title: Learning to Watch: Active Video Anomaly Understanding via Interleaved Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Mengjingcheng Mo, Jiaxu Leng, Xinbo Gao
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Chongqing College of Artificial Intelligence
papers.intro: 论文提出 Anom-π，将视频异常理解重构为闭环顺序决策过程，通过交错策略统一内部认知推理与主动证据采集，并采用交互式直接偏好优化（iDPO）在轨迹级对齐策略，使模型学会主动消歧假设并合理终止。

papers.title: VideoSearch-R1: Iterative Video Retrieval and Reasoning via Soft Query Refinement
papers.authors: Seohyun Lee, Seoung Choi, Dohwan Ko, Jongha Kim, Hyunwoo J. Kim
papers.affiliations: KAIST, Daejeon, Republic of Korea（Seohyun Lee, Seoung Choi, Hyunwoo J. Kim）；Korea University, Seoul, Republic of Korea（Dohwan Ko, Jongha Kim）
papers.intro: VideoSearch-R1提出了一个agentic视频检索与推理框架，通过与视频搜索引擎的多轮交互，并引入连续潜在空间中的软查询细化（SQR），统一了跨视频检索和视频内时间定位两个任务。

papers.title: Learning to Compose: Revisiting Proxy Task Design for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Jingjing Zhang, Lei Zhang, Zheren Fu, Zhendong Mao
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出FoCo（Focus-then-Complete）框架，将零样本组合图像检索中的组合过程建模为"先聚焦修改相关视觉内容，再完成目标语义"的两个阶段，并通过两个代理任务和跨实例对比训练实现可学习的组合机制，在四个ZS-CIR基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: OnPoint: Offline-to-Online Multi-Level Distillation for Point-Supervised Online Temporal Action Localization
papers.authors: Sakib Reza, Gauri Jagatap, Mohsen Moghaddam, Octavia Camps, Andrea Fanelli
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University, Boston, MA, USA; Dolby Laboratories, Inc., San Francisco, CA, USA; Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA, USA
papers.intro: 论文提出OnPoint，利用离线点监督教师模型，通过实例级、帧级、窗口级三级蒸馏将知识迁移给严格在线学生，从而用每个动作实例单一时间点的弱标注实现高效的在线时间动作定位。

papers.title: Reasoning with Memory: A Temporal Granularity-Adaptive Framework for Training-Free Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Linghao Meng, Qiankun Li, Junyuan Mao, Pujin Liao, Zhicheng He, Enbo Zhang, Kun Wang, Yang Liu, Huazhu Fu, Yueming Jin
papers.affiliations: National University of Singapore; Institute of High Performance Computing, Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Singapore; Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; University of Science and Technology of China, Anhui, China; Jilin University, Jilin, China
papers.intro: 提出ReMem，一个基于记忆机制的时间粒度自适应的无训练关键帧选择框架，通过查询级和视频级的双重记忆增强，使MLLMs能够在有限上下文内实现稳健的长视频多粒度推理。

papers.title: Thinking Before Retrieving: Robust Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval via Strategic Planning and Self-Criticism
papers.authors: Gunho Jung, Jeong-Woo Park, Seon Bin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
papers.affiliations: Department of Artificial Intelligence, Korea University, Seoul, 02841, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: PEC-CIR 通过 Planner–Executor–Critic 多阶段推理架构，将零样本组合图像检索的查询构建从单次生成重构为“规划—多候选生成—自我批判”的流程，从而减少生成错误传播并提升检索稳定性。

papers.title: SkillSpotter: Pose-Aware Multi-View Skilled Action Detection and Grading in Ego-Exo Videos
papers.authors: Björn Braun, Christian Holz
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, ETH Zürich, Switzerland
papers.intro: SkillSpotter 提出了一种姿态感知的多视角时序检测与分级架构，通过自适应时序抑制、门控 3D 姿态融合和双向跨视角注意力，在 Ego-Exo4D proficiency 基准上联合完成熟练动作的时间定位与质量分级，显著超过了现有 TAD baseline。

papers.title: Benchmark AUC Is Not Deployable Reliability: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Off-the-Shelf Features for Surveillance Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Mohammadreza Rashidi
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, AI and Media Analysis Lab, Berlin, Germany
papers.intro: 本文通过一个跨数据集审计实验证明：基于冻结预训练特征（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0）+ 最近邻距离的无监督视频异常检测器，在单数据集（同场景）设置下平均AUC为0.704，但跨数据集（跨场景）平均AUC骤降至0.499（接近随机猜测），且最强骨干网络DI…

papers.title: Learning Where and When: Patch-Based Spatiotemporal Localization in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Hamza Karim, Nghia Nguyen, Lokman Bekit, Yasin Yilmaz
papers.affiliations: University of South Florida
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于补丁的弱监督时空异常检测框架，通过近邻感知的Top-k多示例学习策略，在无边界框监督的情况下同时学习异常发生的“时间”和“空间”位置，并发布了新标注数据集以促进该方向的研究。

papers.title: FDM-MFVT: Few-step Sampling Diffusion Model for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.authors: Jiaxin Liu, Xiaoye Liang, Lai Jiang, Mai Xu, Jun Liu
papers.affiliations: Beihang University (School of Electronic Information Engineering, State Key Laboratory of Virtual Reality Technology and Systems); Zhongguancun Academy
papers.intro: 本文提出FDM-MFVT，一个仅需6步采样、完全无掩码的扩散模型，通过Outfit-aware Noise Optimization (OANO) 模块优化噪声初始化，以及Instruction-driven Try-on (IDT) 模块实现文本与视觉引导的试穿，并构建了30,000对的MFVT数…

papers.title: MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching
papers.authors: Zhihong Liu, Zheng Li, Jiachun Jin, Siqi Kou, Yitao Jian, Fengpei Yu, Zhijie Deng
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Triverse AI
papers.intro: 本文提出MirrorPPR框架，通过修图操作提取器与扩散Transformer结合，并配套数据自增强范式和大规模数据集，首次实现了基于示例的精细结构肖像修图。

papers.title: Occlusion-Robust Multi-Object Decoupling for Physics-Based Interaction
papers.authors: Xin Dong, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang
papers.affiliations: Xin Dong - Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University & Pengcheng Laboratory; Wenfeng Deng - Pengcheng Laboratory; Yansong Tang - Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 提出一种无需掩码的、基于联合2D-3D扩散先验和几何相似性正则化的多物体无损解耦方法，从稀疏遮挡视角重建完整物体，实现多物体物理交互仿真。

papers.title: Beyond Trajectory Matching: Reflow with Marginal Distribution Alignment
papers.authors: Chen Wang, Peiran Yun, Pan Xie, Ke Deng
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University (Chen Wang, Peiran Yun, Ke Deng); Bytedance Inc (Pan Xie)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种边际对齐正则化器，通过追踪学生ODE的log密度变化和冻结教师模型的分数估计，在不引入辅助网络或对抗训练的前提下，弥补再流蒸馏中轨迹匹配损失对分布欠定的缺陷，从而提升少步生成质量。

papers.title: ASTAD: Asymmetric Style Transfer for Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Dingyi Yao, Xinqi Zhang, Lihui Peng, Jianming Hu, Danya Yao, Yi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Department of Automation, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China
papers.intro: 论文正式提出“自动驾驶不对称风格迁移”（ASTAD）任务，并设计了无需训练的两阶段框架ASTModel，通过原型引导的语义先验提取和动态语义精化机制，在无标注真实风格图条件下实现语义一致的风格迁移。
